desc:
🐪 RACE CAMELS 🏜️

Hatch camels at the Souq, race them on the track and get rich!
Your camels earn cash in your stable even while you're offline 💰

HOW TO PLAY:
🥚 Buy eggs at the Souq: 10 kinds, from Plain to Royal Jinn
🏁 Bronze, Silver, Gold and Open Cup races every few minutes
🔥 Whip at the right moment in the final stretch for a speed burst
🧬 Rare traits, shiny camels and weather mutations
🌴 Grow food on your farm and feed your camels
🚙 Ride in the car next to your camel while it races
🌪️ Sandstorms, starry nights and oasis rain
🏆 Retire champions to your Hall of Champions for a bonus forever
🔁 Rebirth your camels to make them faster
🌍 Play in English or Arabic

Join the group to unlock Auto Race! 🏆
🎮 Works on PC, phone, tablet and console
